import Architect
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum

set_option warningAsError true
set_option maxHeartbeats 200000

namespace P41Bad

@[blueprint "thm:p41bad-target"]
theorem p41_target (n : ℕ) (h₀ : 0 < n) : 9 ∣ 10 ^ n - 1 := by
  have growth : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ q : ℕ, (10 : ℕ)^m = 9 * q + 1 := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => exact ⟨0, by norm_num⟩
    | succ m ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨q, hq⟩
      refine ⟨10 * q + 1, ?_⟩
      rw [pow_succ, hq]
      ring
  cases n with
  | zero => exact False.elim (Nat.lt_irrefl 0 h₀)
  | succ n =>
    rcases growth (n + 1) with ⟨q, hq⟩
    refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
    omega

end P41Bad

#check (P41Bad.p41_target : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 9 ∣ (10 : ℕ)^n - 1)
#print axioms P41Bad.p41_target

import Architect

set_option warningAsError true

  have sum_divisors : (∑ k ∈ Nat.divisors 500, k) = 1092 := by decide
  have value : a = 1092 := h₀.trans sum_divisors
  subst a
  have filter_eq : (Nat.divisors 1092).filter Nat.Prime = (1092 : ℕ).primeFactors := by
    ext p
    simp [Nat.mem_divisors, Nat.mem_primeFactors, and_assoc, and_comm, and_left_comm]
  have factors : (1092 : ℕ).primeFactors = {2, 3, 7, 13} := by decide
  rw [filter_eq, factors]
  decide

end P138Bad
